title: Feral (bear) druid: picks up a second mob that joins mid-fight

rules.desc: A mob that hits the healer (extra1) or the DPS player gets Growl on it within 5 s, at least 70 percent of the time (one trigger per mob per 12 s, one counted answer per 10 s: Growl's cooldown). A scheduled second mob joins about a minute in (refill_every_s 60) while the first still lives, so its triggers arrive while the single-target taunt may be on cooldown from the first mob Only hits after 55 s count (trigger t_from 55): the scheduled refill_every_s 60 add lands about a minute into the fight, so earlier hits on the first mob are not triggers.
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/TankFeralDruidStrategy.cpp:55-63 (lose aggro -> growl and party member attacked -> growl on attacker, both at ACTION_MOVE); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: the scheduled add opens on the player while the first mob still lives; both growl rows sit at ACTION_MOVE, so whether the bear answers the add while already tanking is the question. Expected UNKNOWN on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62

rules.desc: Precondition: Battle Stance (aura 2457) stays on the player through the fight
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start, this uptime proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the stance is cast in set-up and nothing in the fight removes it; a repeat where it drops shows here instead of passing silently
